title: Concept: Hex dependency overrides the resolved version
description: mix.exs declares an `override: true` flag that pins a version across the tree, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `override: true` flag that pins a version across the tree.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through mix.exs (hex).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `override: true` flag that pins a version across the tree.
